literal_meaning: নদী বা জলাশয়ের উভয় তীর বা পার
figurative_meaning_en: Both banks of a river, from one bank to the other, this side and that side
similar_in_english: from one end to the other
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই পারাপারের যাত্রা অনেক দিন লাগবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Green fields stretch across both banks of the river.
This journey from one side to the other will take many days.
note: Rooted in Bengal's riverine landscape, often evokes the vastness of waterways in everyday expressions.
